input.summary: TOY-002 is implemented on pace/TOY-002 in two commits. greet(*names) now greets any number of people, joining them as "Alice, Bob and Carol" with no Oxford comma. With no names it returns "Hello, world!", and greet("Bob") is unchanged. The CLI greets every argument. Three new tests cover zero, two and three names. pytest isn't installed here, so I ran the four test functions directly with python3 and all passed. I also ran the CLI.
input.commit_message:
TOY-002: greet multiple people

greet() now accepts any number of names, joined as "A, B and C".
No names defaults to "world"; the CLI greets every argument.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
verified: Ran all four test functions in test_greet.py directly with Python 3.13.5 and all passed: test_greet, test_greet_no_names, test_greet_two_names, test_greet_three_names. pytest is not installed, so the test suite was not run under pytest.
CLI: `python3 greet.py Alice Bob` → 'Hello, Alice and Bob!'
CLI: `python3 greet.py Alice Bob Carol` → 'Hello, Alice, Bob and Carol!'
Commits on pace/TOY-002: a8f756b (greet.py change) and 242cf45 (tests). The working tree is clean; I removed the __pycache__ created by the test run.
manual_checks: Run `python -m pytest -q` somewhere pytest is installed. The tests here ran without pytest, and the `python` command does not exist on this machine (only `python3`).
Edge case to decide on: an empty-string argument (`python3 greet.py ""`) prints 'Hello, !'. This was also true before the change, and the plan does not cover it.
The `tuple[str, ...]` hint on _join_names needs Python 3.9 or newer. Confirm that is acceptable.
input.notes: The change follows the approved plan, and bye.py is untouched. This environment has no `python` command and no pytest, so verification used python3 and called the test functions directly.

proposed_items.title: Support multiple people in farewell
proposed_items.description: Give bye.farewell the same multi-name support as greet, and give it type hints and tests.
proposed_items.reason: bye.py mirrors greet.py but has no tests, and only greet handles multiple names after TOY-002.

proposed_items.title: Add .gitignore and test tooling
proposed_items.description: Add a .gitignore for __pycache__ and declare pytest as a dev dependency.
proposed_items.reason: Running the code leaves an untracked __pycache__ directory, and pytest wasn't available in this environment.
